canonical_p3_12.title: Skill Verifier

frozen_contract.scope: The Skill Verifier is the baseline-vs-candidate comparison and token/latency measurement component that gates every skill promotion, alongside evidence, rollback safety, ownership, and versioning.

canonical_p3_12.acceptance_promotion_gates: Every promotion (shadow/advisory/active in the frozen lifecycle; implemented as shadow/candidate/active) must carry recorded evidence, an explicit baseline-vs-candidate comparison, a rollback path, an owner, and a version, before it is authorized.

current_implementation_state.promotion_py: promote()/demote()/promotion_status()/is_active() implement the guarded shadow->candidate->active lifecycle. Guards checked before non-demotion moves: evidence (credit_events or model_skill_outcomes >= 1), frontier_approved, frontier_binding_current, immune_clear, bound, owner, evaluation (baseline-vs-candidate comparison), and version — universal across every candidate source.
current_implementation_state.baseline_comparison: skillforge.record_evaluation() computes an explicit baseline-vs-candidate token comparison (roi.net_tokens_saved) for ANY bound candidate (skills/<level>/<name>/candidate-binding.json), Radar-backed or general frontier-evidence; promotion.promote() refuses to advance unless that evaluation is present, current (lifecycle_content_hash-matched), and passed (evaluation_not_proven / evaluation_stale reasons).
current_implementation_state.version: skillforge.artifact_binding()/promotion._version_check() read a 'version' key from SKILL.md frontmatter; a candidate without a positive integer version is refused (version_missing/version_invalid), and a version that does not strictly exceed this skill's last active version is refused (version_not_incremented).
current_implementation_state.owner: skillforge.bind_candidate(owner=...) persists an explicit, non-empty owner string on candidate-binding.json; promotion._guard_checks()['owner'] requires it before advancement (no_owner reason otherwise).
current_implementation_state.rollback: immune.rollback_log() is checked via the immune_clear guard; a matching skill-<name> rollback record blocks promotion (tested).
current_implementation_state.evidence: credit_events/model_skill_outcomes counts gate promotion; tested and historically dogfooded (milestone-23-policy-promotion.md).
current_implementation_state.cli: brainctl promote|demote|promotions expose the lifecycle; no CLI surface reports baseline comparison, owner, or version explicitly (unchanged; not required by §119).

reuse_decision: Reuse existing promotion.py, skillforge.py (artifact_binding, candidate_binding, record_evaluation, bind_candidate), frontier.py, immune.py, credit/plasticity evidence, and current Universal local CLI. Do not create a second promotion engine, a duplicate OMP-native skill-verification subsystem, or a parallel baseline-comparison mechanism outside the existing evaluation binding. Do not activate the held P3.11 read-reuse candidate in production. Lean remains HOLD_SHADOW.
smallest_genuine_missing_seam: None. The universal §119 gate is implemented: every non-demotion promotion (Radar-backed Skill Forge or general frontier-evidence) now requires an explicit bounded owner (skillforge.bind_candidate owner=), a baseline-vs-candidate evaluation comparison keyed to lifecycle-normalized content (skillforge.record_evaluation/lifecycle_content_hash), and a valid strictly-incrementing version (promotion._version_check), in addition to the pre-existing evidence/frontier/rollback guards. No candidate source is exempt.

implementation_summary.universal_guards: promotion._guard_checks() now computes guards['bound'] (skillforge.candidate_binding() is not None), guards['owner'] (bound and binding.owner is a non-empty string), guards['evaluation'] (bound content hash + evaluation.json both current and status=='passed'), and guards['version'] (promotion._version_check(): a positive integer artifact_version that strictly exceeds any version this skill previously reached active with). promotion.promote() refuses with no_promotion_binding/no_owner/evaluation_not_proven/evaluation_stale/version_missing/version_invalid/version_not_incremented before any filesystem mutation, for every non-demotion move regardless of candidate source.
implementation_summary.cross_hop_hash_fix: skillforge.lifecycle_content_hash() normalizes the SKILL.md 'status:' frontmatter line before hashing (mirroring the pre-existing artifact_binding() frontier hash), so one bind_candidate()/record_evaluation() pair remains valid across the guarded shadow -> candidate -> active path even though _move_skill() mutates the status field in place during each hop. bind_candidate(), record_evaluation(), and promotion._guard_checks() all use this shared normalized hash.
implementation_summary.regenerated_tests: tests/test_p3_12_universal_promotion_gate.py (8 new tests: unbound/general-frontier candidates are refused and promoted identically to Radar-backed ones, missing/malformed/non-incremented version blocks promotion, stale evaluation after content change is rejected). tests/test_promotion.py and tests/test_skill_lifecycle.py updated (6 tests) to bind_candidate()+record_evaluation() before promoting, plus the Hypothesis guard-combination reference model gained a 'bound' dimension matching the real guard order.
implementation_summary.full_suite: Full pytest suite (all test files) passes with zero failures; ruff check and pyright are clean on src and tests; the Prime extension Vitest suite (591/591) is unaffected (Python-only change).

dogfood_evidence.isolated_positive_proof: state/p3_12_dogfood/universal-gate-live-evidence.json: in an isolated temp Brain home, a Radar-backed candidate (source_type=radar, radar_candidate_id=candidate-76c88737ad58a6a525c959f5, the same real Radar signal read-reuse was forged from) and an independent general frontier-evidence candidate (source_type=frontier, no Radar/Skill-Forge lineage) both reach shadow->candidate->active with promoted:true and identical guards={bound,owner,evaluation,version,evidence,frontier_approved,frontier_binding_current,immune_clear}=true, proving one universal decision boundary for two independent candidate sources. The same isolated home also proves a live negative control: an evidenced, frontier-approved, but unbound candidate is refused with reason no_promotion_binding.
